overview: Two concentration units that look almost identical on paper but behave very differently when temperature changes.
genZNote: Chemistry loves making two things look almost identical and then changing everything.

aspects.label: Definition
aspects.valueA: Moles of solute per litre of SOLUTION (mol/L).
aspects.valueB: Moles of solute per kilogram of SOLVENT (mol/kg).

aspects.label: Temperature Dependence
aspects.valueA: Changes with temperature (solution volume expands/contracts with heat).
aspects.valueB: Independent of temperature (mass of solvent doesn't change with temperature).
